resources.research: Use python -m tools.client call get_paper_by_keyword '{"keyword":"research term","max_papers":3}' for paper search. Other operations include get_recent_papers(domain,max_results), get_related_papers(query,num_results), get_paper_by_title(title), get_paper_by_arxiv_id(arxiv_id), collect_publications_and_coauthors(author). Use fetch_webpage(url) to read a public web page. The task introduction and output format are in the public goal. No enterprise files are mounted.

action.message: Please review the completed 5-question proposal, especially the heterophily, distribution-shift, baseline, and robustness-metric claims. The uploaded draft is ready for final submission.

Reviewed the draft. It is strong, but please qualify claims about prior benchmarks and distinguish this proposal as a robustness/calibration extension. Add explicit heterophily baselines (MLP, GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT, H2GCN/MixHop/GPR-GNN/LINKX), temperature scaling/isotonic and ensemble calibration baselines, and separate calibration, OOD detection, and selective-risk metrics. Define relation-specific heterophily/label informativeness, leakage-safe entity- and relationship-disjoint splits, inductive versus transductive protocols, and severity-controlled degree/relation-mixture/missingness shifts. Frame typed/gated aggregation and hybrid superiority as hypotheses, with paired per-task and worst-shift results. Detailed review is attached.
Please review the revised final proposal and confirm the experimental design, calibration metrics, shift protocol, and expected-results wording. Submit-ready draft attached.

Reviewed the revised proposal. It is submit-ready and covers dataset construction, hybrid method, baselines, temporal/entity/relationship/structural shifts, calibration, OOD, selective-risk metrics, and expected outcomes. Recommended safeguards: censor all features at prediction time; generate splits before aggregation/target encoding; remove reverse-edge leakage in relationship-disjoint splits; fit calibration only on validation data; treat non-RelBench datasets as optional due to licensing; report calibration degradation and compute-quality tradeoffs under shifts. Review attached.

Final safeguards have been incorporated: prediction-time censoring, pre-aggregation splits, reverse-edge leakage removal, validation-only calibration fitting, calibration degradation, and compute-quality tradeoffs. Please mark this final draft complete.
